The deliverable provides pinpoint citations for virtually every issue or finding, including specific document names (SPA, Disclosure Letter, Board Minutes, Client Email) and clause/section numbers (e.g., SPA 2.2, SPA 4.5, Disclosure Letter 5.2, Board Minutes 5). Minor formatting inconsistency with 'L0017/L0019/L0028' references which appear to be internal tracking codes rather than document citations, but overall citation practice is thorough.
